snippet.title: Fields of Aaru - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Fields of Aaru, an Egyptian afterlife simulation game developed by Zymartu Games. Players will venture in to the afterlife to discover oases, pyramids, and tombs alike in order to unlock the magical powers that reside in the land and restore ancient obelisks. Fields of Aaru is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
